name: jump-up-cartoon-wobble
style: instrumental only, no vocals. jump-up drum and bass at 174 BPM, a rowdy rave bursting out of a fluorescent-lit council basement, already at full tilt on beat one, no intro, no build. A fat, rubbery wobble bass that honks and lurches like a cartoon tantrum, calling and answering itself with pitch-bending growls and squelchy 90s rave hoover stabs. Bouncy two-step drums: tight punchy kick, a big dry snare cracking hard on every 2 and 4, rattling hats. Gleeful, silly, slapstick vandalism, paper flying everywhere. One repeating 8-bar riff, wall-to-wall, loud and loopable, clean club mix with heavy sub
exclude: vocals, singing, MC, rap, hype shouts, vocal chops, chants, crowd noise, spoken word, humming, choir, ooh ahh, intro, ambient pad, slow build, breakdown, riser, piano, liquid, soft
lyrics:
[Drop: full energy from the first beat, no intro]
[Instrumental]
[Repeat the same 8-bar bass riff, no breakdown]
